title: feat(driver-turso): dual transport — remote-only mode via @libsql/client
body:
TursoDriver only supported local/embedded-replica modes (Knex + better-sqlite3). Pure remote `libsql://` URLs threw an error, blocking Turso's primary cloud/serverless/edge use case.

### Changes

- **`RemoteTransport` class** — Full IDataDriver implementation over `@libsql/client`: CRUD, bulk ops, transactions, schema DDL, MongoDB-style filter compilation to SQL
- **Auto-detected transport mode** — `TursoDriver.detectMode()` resolves `local | replica | remote` from URL scheme; overridable via `config.mode`
- **Method delegation** — All IDataDriver overrides check `isRemote` and delegate to `RemoteTransport`, preserving SqlDriver inheritance for local/replica
- **Client injection** — `config.client` accepts a pre-configured `@libsql/client` instance for custom caching, pooling, or testing

```typescript
// Remote mode — cloud-only, no local SQLite
const driver = new TursoDriver({
  url: 'libsql://my-db.turso.io',
  authToken: process.env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN,
});
await driver.connect();

// Same IDataDriver interface as local mode
const users = await driver.find('users', { where: { active: true } });

// Runtime introspection
driver.transportMode; // 'remote'
driver.isRemote;      // true
```

### Detection logic

| URL | syncUrl | Mode |
|---|---|---|
| `file:` / `:memory:` | — | `local` |
| `file:` / `:memory:` | set | `replica` |
| `libsql://` / `https://` | — | `remote` |

### Test coverage

100 tests (was 55): 12 mode-detection tests + 33 remote-mode CRUD integration tests using injected in-memory `@libsql/client`. All original tests unchanged.

> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>【架构演进】TursoDriver 支持双 transport：Knex(better-sqlite3)+@libsql/client（纯 remote 场景）</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## 背景
> 目前 TursoDriver 只支持本地/embedded-replica/文件/内存这几个场景，所有 CRUD 请求实际都走本地 better-sqlite3/Knex。对于 cloud/serverless/edge-only 的纯 remote (libsql://) 连接，只能 sync 不能直接 query，**无法支持 Turso 云端 DaaS 的主流用法**。
> 
> ## 问题
> - 现有驱动不支持 `url: libsql://...` 场景，只能配合 syncUrl 做 embedded/hybrid offline 模式。
> - 社区/官方文档主推的 Turso serverless/Cloud（Vercel/CF）实际不能用此 Driver。
> - objectql legacy 版本实际上支持 direct @libsql/client CRUD。
> 
> ## 目标
> **升级为双 transport 架构：实现 TursoDriver 可根据 URL/config 自动切换：**
> - A. local file / :memory: / embedded-replica: 保持继承 SqlDriver (Knex+better-sqlite3)，所有查询走本地引擎
> - B. remote only（libsql://）: 直接用 @libsql/client SDK（HTTP/WebSocket）做 CRUD/schema/query，无需本地 DB，不依赖 Knex
> - 二者接口完全一致（IDataDriver），外部无需感知差异
> 
> ## 方案 / 拟实现
> 1. TursoDriver 增加 transport 层 strategy：`mode: 'local' | 'replica' | 'remote'`
> 2. remote-only 场景实现 find/create/update/delete/aggregate/... 直调 @libsql/client API（objectql 旧版本有实现）
> 3. query/schema/filter 编译仍可复用 SqlDriver 逻辑，底层实际执行换为 http fetch
> 4. 开放自定义 fallback/bypass，便于 future: proxy/query router/edge 分布式等拓展
> 5. 补齐 type test 和 remote-only CI
> 
> ## 验收标准
> - 支持所有 cloud-only use case，自动根据 URL 选最优实现
> - IDE/SDK/CLI 全部表现为单一 Driver，无需手工区分
> - 支持传入 @libsql/client driver 实例，便于自定义缓存、上层管理
> - 文档更新，roadmap 标出 phased scope</issue_description>
